Dam Ride (Tuesday Evenings)

Waco, TX · Lake Waco · Road

No-drop

Dam Ride (Tuesday Evenings) is a road group ride in Waco, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:45 pm from Waco Dam. About 25–41 miles, a 20+ mph (drop), B 18–20, C 16–18 (regroup), D 13–15 (no-drop).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a 20+ mph (drop), B 18–20, C 16–18 (regroup), D 13–15 (no-drop). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @wacobicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dam Ride (Tuesday Evenings) group ride

The club's weeknight road ride from Waco Dam. Four groups: A is a drop ride at 20-plus, B and C regroup, D is no-drop at 13 to 15 mph over 25 miles. Helmets required on every WBC ride.
